messages:
olivia: Heads up 4 partner's claim for outpatient shoulder PT was denied as out-of-network. The provider is showing as in-network on the insurer's directory and our benefits portal. How do we escalate?
ben: Ugh that's annoying. Can you DM the member ID and a screenshot of the insurer directory listing showing the provider as in-network? Also get the EOB and the provider's tax ID/NPI.
benefits-bot: Please submit a network discrepancy ticket at https://benefits.redwood.example.com/network-discrepancy and attach: 1) insurer directory screenshot, 2) EOB, 3) provider NPI/TIN, 4) date(s) of service. Process time ~7 business days; mark as urgent if this affects member cost-share.
olivia: DM sent with member ID + screenshot + EOB. Provider NPI included. The member already paid $120 OOP at time of service.
anna-network: Thanks 4 I'll open a provider-relations escalation with the insurer and include the directory screenshot and claim details. If insurer confirms provider is in-network, they should reprocess and issue an adjusted EOB.
ben: Also capture the provider's clinic website page where they claim to be in-network. Insurers sometimes fail to sync. If we get proof they were listed, it strengthens an appeal.
kelly-caseworker: Process note 4 after you file the discrepancy ticket, email people-ops@redwood.com with subject "URGENT: network discrepancy Member 5XXXXX" so we assign a case manager. We'll request an expedited re-adjudication and track reimbursement to member.
olivia: Done 4 ticket filed and people-ops emailed. Any estimate on timeframe for reimbursement if insurer agrees?
anna-network: If insurer accepts the directory error, reprocessing typically issues a corrected EOB within 10 business days and sends payment or adjustment to the provider. Member reimbursement can vary but often 7-14 days after adjustment. We'll push for faster turnaround given the out-of-pocket.
ben: If insurer refuses, we can file an appeal on benefit-error grounds and escalate to state department of insurance if needed. Collect all evidence (screenshots with timestamps, phone call logs with provider, payment receipts).
olivia: Provider confirmed they billed as in-network and said they got no notice of termination. They also sent a screenshot. Uploading now.
kelly-caseworker: Case created: ND-2026-77. Assigned to kelly-caseworker. I'll coordinate with anna-network and follow up within 48 hours.
benefits-bot: Reminder 4 save all receipts and the EOB PDF. If you want a templated appeal letter, reply and I'll post it.
olivia: Appreciate it 4 can I get the appeal template?
benefits-bot: Posting template: "To: providerrelations@insurer.example.com
Subject: Appeal and re-adjudication request  Network discrepancy and incorrect in-network status  Member 5XXXXX
Body: Member details, date of service, provider details (NPI/TIN), attached directory screenshot dated [mm/dd/yyyy], provider confirmation screenshot, EOB showing denial as out-of-network. Request: re-adjudicate as in-network and reimburse member $120 paid at time of service. Please confirm receipt and estimated resolution timeline.
"
